name: SoChain API
description:
SoChain API v3. Lookups work without a key. Send your key in the `API-KEY` header (`X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer` also work) for your plan's monthly requests, and for buckets, webhooks, /account_info and /support, which always need one (without it they answer 401: "This endpoint needs an API key: send it as the API-KEY header.").

Answers are JSON: `{"status": "success", "data": …}` or `{"status": "fail", "data": {"error_message": "…"}}`; only `/account_info` answers without the envelope, and `format=csv` history exports are CSV. A method an endpoint doesn't take answers 405, naming the ones it does ("This endpoint takes GET."); GET on the base URL answers where the docs, this document and MCP are. Amounts are exact 8-decimal strings, times Unix seconds, hashes lowercase hex (any case is read). Prices are in US dollars, or the currency you ask for: always 0 on testnets, and null on a mainnet where there's no price (before its price history, or a block stamped ahead of the clock). An answer a few blocks behind carries a Warning header ("1 block behind: answered as of block 971060"), and one without its prices "Warning: price unavailable".

Networks: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC (Zcash), BTCTEST (Bitcoin testnet4), LTCTEST (Litecoin testnet4), DOGETEST (Dogecoin testnet) and ZECTEST (Zcash testnet). On Zcash, the transparent side only.

Limits: without a key, lookups are 2,500 a UTC day per IP (an IPv6 /48 counts as one), API and MCP together; past that they answer 429, and more needs a key. Paid plans have reserved capacity and are served first when it's busy. With a key, requests per calendar month (UTC) by plan: Free 75,000, Hobby 500,000, Starter 1,500,000, Professional 15,000,000, Behemoth 150,000,000. Past the month's quota, lookups carry on at the keyless rate (still 200, with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0) while webhooks and streams pause until the 1st or an upgrade; once that rate is used up too, keyed calls answer 401. Answers carry X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (seconds until the count resets: the month with a key, the UTC day without); 401, 403 and 429 refusals don't.

Live WebSocket streams (every paid plan) are at /api/v3/stream on the same host, with the same key. The same data is available to AI agents over MCP at https://sochain.com/mcp with the same key and limits.

Webhook deliveries carry SoChain-Signature: verify it before trusting a payload, and reply with any 2xx within 30 seconds, or the delivery is retried.
